items.title: Premarket movers: Palo Alto soars, chip stocks rally ahead of Anthropic debut
items.summary: Investing.com -- U.S. equity futures jumped early Thursday after Anthropic’s initial public offering priced above expectations, reviving enthusiasm for artificial intelligence stocks. Dow Jones Industrial Average futures rose 0.6%, S&P 500 futures gained 1.2% and Nasdaq-100 futures surged 2.1%.
